# Davidson Institute

> The Davidson Institute provides comprehensive programs and support for profoundly gifted youth, including scholarships, summer programs, online courses, and full-time academies.

Based in Reno, Nevada, the Davidson Institute serves highly gifted students ages 5-18 across the United States and Canada through free family support programs, residential summer opportunities, competitive fellowships, and specialized schools. The organization focuses on identifying and nurturing exceptionally talented youth through multiple educational pathways.

## Key Topics

- Profoundly gifted students
- Young Scholars program
- Davidson Fellows Scholarship
- Davidson Academy Online
- Davidson Academy Reno
- Summer programs
- Gifted education

- STEM and humanities courses
- Family support
- Admissions

- Online learning

## Core Programs

- [Gifted Programs Overview](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs): Overview of Davidson Institute's gifted programs and educational offerings
- [Young Scholars Program](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/young-scholars): Young Scholars program for ages 5-18 offering free family support and community for highly gifted students
- [Davidson Academy](https://www.davidsongifted.org/the-davidson-academy): Davidson Academy Online and Reno schools for highly gifted students with specialized curricula
- [Davidson Fellows Scholarship](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/fellows-scholarship): Competitive scholarship program offering $25,000-$100,000 awards to gifted students for exceptional projects
- [Davidson Explore](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/explore): Online courses for gifted middle schoolers ages 9-13 in STEM and humanities subjects

## Summer & Enrichment Opportunities

- [Summer Opportunities Overview](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/summer-opportunities): Summer program options including camps and family events for gifted youth
- [Davidson Summer Programs](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/summer-opportunities/davidson-summer-programs): Residential summer programs for ages 8-13 with academic workshops and peer community
- [Annual Family Events](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/summer-opportunities/annual-family-events): Annual family events including Davidson Summit for community building and networking

## For Prospective Families

- [Prospective Families Resources](https://www.davidsongifted.org/prospective-families): Resources for prospective families on gifted identification and parenting strategies
- [Upcoming Events](https://www.davidsongifted.org/prospective-families/upcoming-events): Upcoming conferences and events including admissions Q&A sessions and webinars

## Community & Members

- [Members Portal](https://www.davidsongifted.org/members): Members-only portal for Young Scholars, Alumni, and parent community access
- [Alumni Community](https://www.davidsongifted.org/gifted-programs/alumni): Alumni community engagement and networking for Davidson program graduates
